reviewer_notes: Accepted for the cleaned 64px Nie Feng wind-snow blade hero sprite pack. Idle and move were post-processed to remove many detached white/ice-blue frost specks that made the in-game model look noisy, while the character identity, 8-direction layout, frame separation, and action readability are preserved. Basic attack, cast, hit, and death remain from the accepted codex-gateway-imagegen source set.
